description:
## yt-dlp Media Downloader

A polished GUI for [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) inside AppOS — paste a URL, pick a format, download.

**Features**

- Streaming download progress with speed and ETA
- Playlist support
- Library browser with media playback
- Format and quality presets (mp4, webm, mp3, m4a, best)
- Clipboard paste-and-download
- Command-palette actions and menubar quick access

**System requirements**

- `yt-dlp` (required) — `brew install yt-dlp`
- `ffmpeg` (optional, enables format conversion and merging) — `brew install ffmpeg`
